key_insight: LiteAdaNCA-Net uses token-conditioned neural cellular automata to refine ultrasound segmentation iteratively, improving boundary detail with low computational cost.
clinical_relevance: This could make accurate point-of-care ultrasound segmentation more feasible on portable and resource-limited devices.
method: Structure-aware tokens guide local refinement through Token FiLM.
A lightweight NCA adapter iteratively sharpens segmentation features.
Designed for efficient deployment while preserving boundary awareness.
evidence_signal: The model was evaluated on HC18, CCA, PSFHS, and two external African fetal head datasets, achieving top Dice scores on HC18 (96.62%) and CCA (92.86%) and remaining competitive under domain shift.
watch_item: Performance may vary across sites and scanners, so external validation and careful integration are still needed before real-world deployment.
paper_title: Efficient Ultrasound Image Segmentation with Token-Conditioned Neural Cellular Automata
